## MC Hoster 3.5.0: Laura

- **AI · Laura.** A third button at the top, next to Server hosting and Server sharing. Tell Laura what plugin you want and she writes it, builds it on your PC against your server's own jar, fixes it herself if it doesn't build (up to 3 times, free), and adds it to the server.
  - Pick a **size** (Small €0.25, Normal €0.50, Big €1) and how hard she **thinks** (Normal, High, and Max with the plan).
  - **15 free plugins every month.** After that, add to your balance (€1, €5 or €10) or get the **Laura Plan** (€10 a month: 150 plugins, the strongest model, Max thinking).
  - Paying opens a secure **Stripe** window inside MC Hoster. MC Hoster never sees your card.
  - "Change the last plugin" sends Laura the plugin she just made, so you can ask for changes.
  - Every plugin and its source code are saved in `Documents\MC Hoster Plugins\Laura`.
  - Laura makes plugins for Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish and Spigot. Start the server once before using her on it.
- **My plugins** (tab 5): put your own plugins in `Documents\MC Hoster Plugins` (or add your own folders), tick them, Apply. Replace a file in the folder and the server gets the new one on its next start.
- **The Dark plugins are no longer included** in MC Hoster. Servers that already have them keep them.
- New website: https://mc-hoster.onrender.com
